vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component implements the core security layer for the server, managing device pairing, request authentication, and policy enforcement. It handles network trust validation, rate limiting per IP, and token lifecycle management via a persistent DeviceStore. All critical security events are logged to an audit trail, ensuring a comprehensive record of access control decisions.
